snippet.title: Canvas of Thoughts | Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
This is Canvas of Thoughts, a narrative game in which dialogue is driven by emotion rather than words.

Play as Evi, an 11-year-old girl who is trying to make sense of a world that can seem overwhelming, hectic and unpredictable.

Choose how moments feel, not what is said.

Add to your Steam wishlist and follow development for updates.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348770/Canvas_of_Thoughts/
